pages.text: A $(item)Turret Pedestal$() turns a jarred mob head into a guard that fights the way the mob did. A $(item)Cerebral Array$() racks nine heads that make power by thinking about $(item)Nutrient Broth$(); five or more hold a Board Meeting. A $(item)Neural Socket$() lets your own jar drive six redstone channels, or runs a mob head as a little program.
